title: Funky Pozole Custard Baked
description: A unique dessert that combines the flavors of baked custard with the spiciness of pozole, finished with a bouncy qq topping.
instructions: Prepare the baked custard according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, mix together the pozole and funky spices (if using).
Pour the custard into the preheated Dutch oven.
Top the custard with the pozole mixture.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the custard is set.
Prepare the qq topping by mixing together the ingredients (see notes).
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and top the baked custard with the qq topping.
Return the Dutch oven to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes or until the topping is golden brown.
Remove the Dutch oven from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
